name: agent-fusion
description: Gate-first multi-model orchestration for Claude Code — prove the work with a gate written before the code, build in parallel against a frozen contract, and review with three independent models.

plugins.name: fusion
plugins.description: The fusion:fuse and fusion:pr-evidence workflows plus a fail-open push gate. Divergent work (scout, plan, review) runs blind and in parallel so agreement is evidence, not an echo; convergent work (build) runs coordinated against a contract the architect freezes up front. Model-agnostic: roles are slots, not model names.
